name: Canvs.io
description: Digital whiteboard for real-time visual collaboration, brainstorming and diagramming on the infinite canvas for sketching ideas, diagrams, flowcharts, customer journeys, mind maps, storyboards and more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Canvs.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Canvs.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.canvs.io/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Canvs.io MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Canvs.io provides these MCP tools: get_guide, add_elements, update_elements, delete_elements, query_elements, group_elements, ungroup_elements, align_elements, distribute_elements, lock_elements, unlock_elements, and add_elements_from_mermaid.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Canvs.io?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Canvs.io in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aster-share, and aquent-jobs.
Canvs.io does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Canvs.io is developed by Canvs.io. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
